 사진 확대 A, known as Kim Hyun-joong’s former partner, has started working as a creator under the stage name SeeU. [Photo: ‘Lightning Central’] A, known as the former partner of singer and actor Kim Hyun-joong, has started working as a creator under the stage name SeeU.
 According to AtStyle on the 22nd, A is affiliated with the TikTok live-streaming agency ‘Lightning Central’ and is working as a creator under the stage name SeeU.
 SeeU, who opened a TikTok account last month, has recently hosted live streams and interacted with viewers.
 SeeU is known for a paternity lawsuit involving Kim Hyun-joong. She dated Kim for about three years starting in 2012 and gave birth to a son in September 2015. During this period, she filed a damages lawsuit seeking 1.6 billion won, claiming that she had suffered emotional distress while pregnant with the child and amid conflict over the matter.
 Kim Hyun-joong filed a countersuit, alleging defamation through false statements. However, paternity testing confirmed that the child was Kim Hyun-joong’s biological child. SeeU is now raising the child on her own.
